name: Laguna Beach Residences Bayside
shortDescription: Beachside condominium apartments from about 73 sqm up to large penthouses, part of Banyan Group's Laguna Phuket master plan at Bang Tao.
description:
Laguna Beach Residences Bayside is a low-rise condominium within the Laguna Phuket master plan at Bang Tao, a development of the Banyan Group. Agent listings describe apartments from about 73 sqm up to penthouses of roughly 359 sqm.

Agent sources disagree on the exact number of units (234 to 237) and on the completion date (between Q2 and Q4 2028), so we show only the year. A payment plan of five 20% steps tied to signing, construction progress and completion appears in one agent listing; confirm it with us before relying on it.

Prices differ between agents. The starting price shown is the lowest we found; ask us on WhatsApp for the current price list.
